items.q: most of the songs that I picked for myself, are songs that I think Frank Sinatra, you know, would do well.

ctx.x: How about modern songs. This is something special.

This is one of the problems that good ol' singers have. Most pop tunes are written for guys. MR. HUGHES: Really? MS. SULLIVAN: Yeah. And it's very difficult to find songs that girls sing, you know. It's not easy. The guys can be as personal as they want to be. Like, "I loved you so and so and so and so." Girls have to sing songs in which they're not included, you know.
